voice.text: The swing moves. [pause] The top moves. [pause] Do they move the same way? Tap your guess.
Some things move <emphasis>straight</emphasis>. [pause] One line — there it goes!
Some things move in a <emphasis>circle</emphasis>. [pause] The horse travels around a path. Around, and around.
Some things <emphasis>spin</emphasis>. The top turns in one spot. [pause] It does not travel around a path like the horse. [pause] Spinning and circular are different!
Some things move <emphasis>back and forth</emphasis>. [pause] Forward… back… forward… back.
Pluck! [pause] The rubber band moves back and forth very fast. That is <emphasis>vibrating</emphasis>. [pause] Vibrating makes the sound you hear. [pause] Every sound comes from something moving!
Watch each thing move. [pause] Then tap its motion: straight, circular, spinning, or back and forth.
All nine sorted! [pause] Now show what you know.
Not quite. Spinning turns in <emphasis>one spot</emphasis>. [pause] This one travels around a path — that is circular.
Not quite. Look — it goes nowhere! It turns in one spot. [pause] That is spinning.
Not quite. Look closely — it moves back and forth very fast. [pause] That fast wiggle is vibrating, and vibrating makes the sound.
Not quite. It goes forward, then back, then again. [pause] The repeat means back and forth.
Not quite. Watch the path it makes, then try again.
Yes! [pause] It moves in one line — straight.
Yes! [pause] It turns in one spot — spinning.
Yes! [pause] It travels around a path — circular.
Yes! [pause] Forward, back, again — back and forth.
Yes! [pause] The skin vibrates — fast back and forth. That makes the sound!
Yes! [pause] Down the hill in one line — straight.
Yes! [pause] The string vibrates — fast back and forth. That is the sound you hear!
Yes! [pause] It turns in one spot — spinning.
Yes! [pause] It travels around a big round path — circular.
A ball rolls across the floor in one line. How does it move?
A top turns fast in one spot. How does it move?
A horse on a merry-go-round travels around and around a path. How does it move?
A swing goes forward, then back, then forward again. How does it move?
You hear a drum boom. What made the sound?
<soft>You can name all four motions!</soft> [pause] Well done.
